days ago\u003C\/b\u003E when she developed \u003Cb\u003Echest\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Epain\u003C\/b\u003E which was \u003Cb\u003Esudden\u003C\/b\u003E in onset, non progressive and non radiating. She was taken to an RMP, where she was given an injection and tablets after which the pain was relieved.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(230, 145, 56);\"\u003E\u003Cb\u003E3 days ago\u003C\/b\u003E she suffered an episode of \u003Cb\u003Eloss\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Eof\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Econsciousness\u003C\/b\u003E after working in the sun and later standing in a line for long. It was associated with \u003Cb\u003Ecold and clammy\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Epalms and soles\u003C\/b\u003E, \u003Cb\u003Eprofuse\u003C\/b\u003E \u003Cb\u003Esweating\u003C\/b\u003E.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cspan style=\"caret-color: rgb(230, 145, 56);\"\u003EIt was not associated with blurring of style=\"caret-color: rgb(230, 145, 56);\"\u003EShe was brought to the hospital and she regained consciousness after receiving IV fluids.\u003C\/span\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr
